message: The other day, I was in the kitchen making dinner when I heard that familiar beep from the smoke alarm. Instead of rolling my eyes, I actually felt a bit smug—after all, I had finally replaced the batteries just last week! 😌 It reminded me how easy it is to forget these little things until they become big headaches. So, if you haven’t checked your smoke alarms lately, consider this your friendly nudge. Because nothing feels better than being prepared and saying, "I told you so!" to your future self.
